outcome: Age at diagnosis of late-onset sepsis
cohort: 97 infants with culture-confirmed late-onset sepsis presenting to an urban tertiary care center from 2013 to 2017
finding: The pathogen distribution differed from previous reports, with a higher prevalence of S. aureus, and encounter location and age at presentation varied by pathogen.
mod_finding: Gram-positive organisms were more common in infants delivered through cesarean section and were associated with more complications.
